{{Top|leg}}
A '''"Pheromone Zone" Generator''' was a module installed in a [[Malkite poisoner's kit]]. The module confused [[Olfactory sensor/Legends|olfactory sensor]] and organic "food sniffers", rendering them unable to detect any [[Poison/Legends|poison]] in food or drink.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
